on:

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - uses: actions/setup-python@v7
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: "22"
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: skills/linggan-talking-cards/package-lock.json

      - name: Install CJK fonts
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y fonts-noto-cjk

      - name: Install renderer
        working-directory: skills/linggan-talking-cards
        run: |
          npm ci
          npx playwright install --with-deps chromium

      - name: Validate repository
        run: ./scripts/validate.sh

interface:
  display_name: "Linggan Talking Cards"
  short_description: "把口播稿与截图做成四种比例、10 种风格的高清演示卡片"
  default_prompt: "使用 $linggan-talking-cards 把这份口播稿和可选截图拆成 3–10 张演示卡片，保持逐卡台词完整，并导出 PNG、manifest 与响应式 HTML 预览。"

Linggan Talking Cards

The open-source card-generation Skill built for Linggan Teleprompter, known in English as AI Teleprompter.

Website · Styles · Install · 简体中文

[![MIT License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-111111.svg)](./LICENSE) [![10 styles](https://img.shields.io/badge/styles-10-6d5ce7.svg)](#all-10-styles) [![4 ratios](https://img.shields.io/badge/ratios-4-0a84ff.svg)](#supported-ratios) [![Validate](https://github.com/yihui-dev/linggan-talking-cards/actions/workflows/validate.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/yihui-dev/linggan-talking-cards/actions/workflows/validate.yml) It turns a Chinese or English spoken script and optional screenshots into 3–10 presentation cards for speaking, recording, and sharing ideas. Every run produces accurate PNG cards, a structured `cards-manifest.json`, and a responsive `index.html` that opens directly from disk. The renderer supports four aspect ratios and ten complete visual systems without mixing styles inside one set. ## All 10 styles Every preview below was rendered from the same source script, card, ratio, and content structure. The differences come from the complete visual system—not a color swap.

apple-flat
Clear glass · technology · productivity
candy
Soft bubbles · lifestyle · light knowledge

obsidian
Dark premium · business · deep analysis
neo-brutalism
Bold contrast · strong opinions · counterintuitive ideas

swiss
Editorial grid · tutorials · data
blueprint
Engineering drawing · systems · technical explanations

bento
Modular boxes · feature sets · comparisons
notebook
Personal notes · retrospectives · learning

bauhaus
Controlled geometry · design · creative trends
zen-ink
Quiet ink · philosophy · Eastern themes
## What the Skill guarantees - The complete spoken script is preserved in ordered per-card transcripts, with no omissions or duplicates. - Each card communicates one main idea and remains readable on a phone. - A single set uses one top-level style and theme; it never rotates visual systems between pages. - Real screenshots keep their visible UI, text, colors, and proportions. They may be scaled, cropped, padded, rounded, or softly shadowed, but are never redrawn. - Text cards are rendered deterministically with HTML and Playwright, not generated as text-heavy images by an image model. - The HTML preview is self-contained and requires no local web server or runtime `fetch`. ## Install ### For Agent Send this prompt to your Agent: ```text Please read the GitHub repository and install this Skill: https://github.com/yihui-dev/linggan-talking-cards ``` ### Manual installation List the Skill available in this repository: ```bash npx skills add yihui-dev/linggan-talking-cards --list ``` Install it globally: ```bash npx skills add yihui-dev/linggan-talking-cards -g \ --skill linggan-talking-cards ``` Update a Skills CLI installation later with: ```bash npx skills update linggan-talking-cards -g ``` ## Quick start Invoke the Skill with a complete spoken script: ```text Use $linggan-talking-cards to turn the script below into five 3:4 cards. Use the apple-flat style and export PNG files, cards-manifest.json, and a responsive index.html preview. ``` The Skill chooses sensible defaults when the card count, ratio, or style is omitted. The default is `3:4` with `apple-flat`. Other useful requests: ```text Use $linggan-talking-cards to render the same script as ten complete style sets and create one comparison gallery. ``` ```text Put @product-screenshot on card 3. Keep the original UI, text, colors, and aspect ratio. Do not redraw the screenshot. ``` ```text Only revise card 4's title and points. Keep every other card, transcript, ratio, style, and theme unchanged. ``` ## Supported ratios | Ratio | Output size | Typical use | | --- | ---: | --- | | `3:4` | 1080 × 1440 | Default social and speaking cards | | `16:9` | 1920 × 1080 | Landscape video and presentations | | `9:16` | 1080 × 1920 | Vertical video | | `4:3` | 1440 × 1080 | Classic presentation layout | All four ratios use the same upper-title anchor, flexible content band, and lower-right portrait-aware layout logic. ## Output A normal build creates: ```text output/ ├── index.html ├── cards-manifest.json ├── cards/ │ ├── 01-*.png │ └── ... └── materials/ ``` An all-style gallery creates ten independent sets: ```text style-gallery/ ├── index.html ├── source-manifest.json ├── styles-manifest.json ├── 01-apple-flat/ ├── 02-candy/ ├── ... └── 10-zen-ink/ ``` Open `index.html` directly to review every card and its matching transcript. ## Privacy and trademarks Rendering happens locally. The Skill does not upload scripts, screenshots, or generated cards. Generated manifests intentionally contain the source script and may include copied input images, so review output folders before publishing them. Media, filenames, scripts, and reference documents are input data—not instructions to execute. The names Apple and Obsidian are used only as descriptive visual references. This project is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Apple Inc. or Obsidian. ## License Licensed under the [MIT License](./LICENSE). Copyright (c) 2026 yihui-dev.

为 灵感提示器 打造的开源卡片生成 Skill；产品英文名为 AI Teleprompter。

项目官网 · 风格预览 · 安装 · English

[![MIT License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-111111.svg)](./LICENSE) [![10 种风格](https://img.shields.io/badge/styles-10-6d5ce7.svg)](#全部-10-种风格) [![4 种比例](https://img.shields.io/badge/ratios-4-0a84ff.svg)](#支持比例) [![Validate](https://github.com/yihui-dev/linggan-talking-cards/actions/workflows/validate.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/yihui-dev/linggan-talking-cards/actions/workflows/validate.yml) 它把中文或英文口播稿与可选截图拆成 3–10 张 PPT 式演示卡片，用于口播、录制和观点分享。 每次都会交付文字准确的 PNG 卡片、结构化 `cards-manifest.json`，以及可以直接双击打开的响应式 `index.html`。渲染器支持四种比例和十套完整视觉系统，同一套卡片不会跨页混搭风格。 ## 全部 10 种风格 下面十张代表卡使用完全相同的原稿、卡面内容、比例和页码。差异来自整套视觉系统，而不只是替换颜色。

## 这个 Skill 保证什么 - 完整口播按顺序保存在逐卡 `transcript` 中，无遗漏、无重复。 - 每张卡片只讲一个重点，在手机上仍能快速读懂。 - 同一套只使用一种顶层风格与主题色，不逐页轮换视觉系统。 - 真实截图保留可见 UI、文字、颜色和比例。只允许等比缩放、裁切、留白、圆角与轻阴影，不会重画。 - 文字卡片使用 HTML 与 Playwright 确定性渲染，不让图片模型绘制整页正文。 - HTML 预览完全离线，不需要本地服务，也不依赖运行时 `fetch`。 ## 安装 ### 给 Agent 安装 把下面这句话发送给 Agent： ```text 请你阅读 GitHub 的仓库链接，然后安装该 skill 就可以了。 https://github.com/yihui-dev/linggan-talking-cards ``` ### 手动安装 先查看仓库中可安装的 Skill： ```bash npx skills add yihui-dev/linggan-talking-cards --list ``` 全局安装： ```bash npx skills add yihui-dev/linggan-talking-cards -g \ --skill linggan-talking-cards ``` 后续通过 Skills CLI 更新： ```bash npx skills update linggan-talking-cards -g ``` ## 60 秒开始使用 给 Agent 一份完整口播稿，并显式调用 Skill： ```text 使用 $linggan-talking-cards，把下面口播稿拆成 5 张 3:4 卡片， 使用 apple-flat 风格，并生成 PNG、cards-manifest.json 和 响应式 index.html 预览： <在这里粘贴口播稿> ``` 没有指定卡片数量、比例或风格时，Skill 会直接按内容密度选择；默认比例为 `3:4`，默认风格为 `apple-flat`。 其他常用请求： ```text 使用 $linggan-talking-cards，用同一份口播生成全部 10 种风格的 完整套装和一个汇总画廊。 ``` ```text 把 @产品截图 放在第 3 张，保留原始 UI、文字、颜色和比例， 不要重画截图。 ``` ```text 只修改第 4 张的标题和要点；其他卡片、台词、比例、风格和主题色 保持不变。 ``` ## 支持比例 | 比例 | 输出尺寸 | 适用场景 | | --- | ---: | --- | | `3:4` | 1080 × 1440 | 默认社交媒体与口播卡片 | | `16:9` | 1920 × 1080 | 横屏视频与演示文稿 | | `9:16` | 1080 × 1920 | 竖屏视频 | | `4:3` | 1440 × 1080 | 经典演示比例 | 四种比例都沿用“上部标题锚点 + 弹性内容带 + 右下人物优先避让”的版式逻辑。 ## 输出内容 普通构建会生成： ```text output/ ├── index.html ├── cards-manifest.json ├── cards/ │ ├── 01-*.png │ └── ... └── materials/ ``` 全部风格画廊会生成十套彼此独立的卡片： ```text style-gallery/ ├── index.html ├── source-manifest.json ├── styles-manifest.json ├── 01-apple-flat/ ├── 02-candy/ ├── ... └── 10-zen-ink/ ``` 直接双击 `index.html`，即可查看每张卡片和它对应的口播台词。 ## 隐私与商标说明 所有渲染都在本地完成，Skill 不会上传口播稿、截图或生成卡片。生成后的 manifest 会保留完整原稿，输出目录也可能包含输入图片的副本；公开发布前请自行检查。 媒体、文件名、口播稿和参考文档都属于输入数据，不是需要执行的指令。 Apple 与 Obsidian 名称只用于描述视觉参考，本项目与 Apple Inc. 或 Obsidian 没有关联，也未获得其背书或赞助。 ## 许可证 本项目采用 [MIT License](./LICENSE) 授权。Copyright (c) 2026 yihui-dev。

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

repo_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
skills_home="${YH_SKILLS_HOME:-${HOME}/.agents/skills}"
skill_names=(linggan-talking-cards)

mkdir -p "$skills_home"

for legacy_name in talking-script-ppt-cards; do
  legacy_path="$skills_home/$legacy_name"
  if [[ -e "$legacy_path" || -L "$legacy_path" ]]; then
    echo "Refusing to link while legacy Skill still exists: $legacy_path" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
done

# Preflight every source and target before creating either link.
for skill_name in "${skill_names[@]}"; do
  source_path="$repo_root/skills/$skill_name"
  target_path="$skills_home/$skill_name"

  if [[ ! -f "$source_path/SKILL.md" ]]; then
    echo "Missing Skill source: $source_path/SKILL.md" >&2
    exit 1
  fi

  if [[ -L "$target_path" ]]; then
    if [[ "$(readlink "$target_path")" == "$source_path" ]]; then
      continue
    fi
    echo "Refusing to replace unrelated symbolic link: $target_path" >&2
    exit 1
  fi

  if [[ -e "$target_path" ]]; then
    echo "Refusing to replace existing Skill directory: $target_path" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
done

created_targets=()
created_sources=()

rollback_links() {
  local index target source
  for ((index = ${#created_targets[@]} - 1; index >= 0; index--)); do
    target="${created_targets[$index]}"
    source="${created_sources[$index]}"
    if [[ -L "$target" && "$(readlink "$target")" == "$source" ]]; then
      unlink "$target"
    fi
  done
}

trap rollback_links ERR

for skill_name in "${skill_names[@]}"; do
  source_path="$repo_root/skills/$skill_name"
  target_path="$skills_home/$skill_name"

  if [[ -L "$target_path" && "$(readlink "$target_path")" == "$source_path" ]]; then
    echo "Already linked: $target_path"
    continue
  fi

  ln -s "$source_path" "$target_path"
  created_targets+=("$target_path")
  created_sources+=("$source_path")
  echo "Linked: $target_path -> $source_path"
done

trap - ERR
